jobs.title: Assistant
jobs.description:
Core Job Responsibilities
File Management: Opening new official files and maintaining an accurate, updated record of file movements.
Case Referencing: Examining incoming cases and putting up previous papers, relevant rules, or background references relating to the case under consideration.
Record Upkeep: Keeping a record of all important administrative orders and policy decisions.
File Lifecycle Management: Structuring the recording, indexing, tracking, and systematic weeding of obsolete files.
Security & Prioritisation: Monitoring the assignment of priority or security labels (e.g., "Immediate", "Confidential") on files and proactively advising the Section Officer when these labels can safely be removed.
General Clerical Support: Performing other routine ministerial tasks, which include maintaining the diary register, drafting reminders, casual typing, and preparing numerical statements or data
